hypothesis: Content reconstruction through the actual spike-derived partition supplies object-content credit without an independently trained decoder that can ignore assignments.
existing_loss: Unchanged phase-primary plus 5 times actual positive-component spike-product priors.

hard_partition.classifier: Exact production spike_synchrony_components followed by spatial_components_to_patch_labels
hard_partition.H: one_hot production labels, with columns 0 through max label; removed largest component and every omitted patch share background column 0

surrogate.Q: Live production actual-component positive-Pearson product, training settle32
surrogate.X: Detached native RGB 8x8 patch means, same literal training image IDs
surrogate.mu: (W.T @ X) / clamp(W.sum(0)[:,None], min=1e-8); numerator and denominator remain live
surrogate.R_image: mean((W @ mu - X)^2) / clamp(detached mean spatial RGB variance, min=1e-6)
surrogate.R_batch: Ordinary mean across all16 images, including one-group and blank images
surrogate.interpretation: Exact hard classifier forward with approximate Q-derived backward credit; not a derivative of thresholding or BFS.

calibration: Once, on source seed0 first4 registered TRAIN batches: lambda=0.25*median(old eligible-core gradient norm / RGB eligible-core gradient norm). Same lambda for every seed; no GT calibration.
preflight_required: Exact W.detach()==H and exact production-label equality
Finite nonzero aggregate RGB gradient to Q and eligible core on each first4 TRAIN batch
Fixed count-preserving H row permutation, followed by prototype repooling, has positive mean scrambled-minus-real reconstruction loss
Frozen encoder/graph identity and source/cache/order fingerprints
Stop on failure; no post-failure guard, coefficient or warmup tuning
diagnostics: eligible-core old/RGB gradient norms and cosine
risks: One-group images cannot create a new object through this loss
Identical RGB prototypes or homogeneous groups can yield zero credit
Mixed-content background can encourage nuisance fragmentation
evaluation: Unchanged primary320-image fixed-patch contract; paired seed0 pilot first, then seeds1/2 and70k only if justified. Final objective remains three-seed mean strict improvement on all three comparable Slot metrics.
